detail.longDescription:
One prompt. One live app. AI agents, automations, and your data built in. Create apps, tools, and dashboards with Taskade Genesis. 

Build your own CRM, client portal, booking page, or business software just by describing it.

Taskade builds the screens, database, AI agents, and workflows, all connected.

No code. No setup. Imagine it. Run it live.

YOUR BUSINESS. YOUR SOFTWARE.

You know your business better than anyone. Now build the software it runs on.

BUILD THE APP YOUR WORK NEEDS

- CRM: Track leads, customers, deals, and follow-ups.
- Booking page: Let customers book services and get reminders.
- Client portal: Share updates, files, and invoices.
- Jobs board: Give your crew schedules, tasks, and updates.
- Invoices and quotes: Track billing and overdue payments.
- Dashboard: See sales, projects, and performance.
- Forms: Collect inquiries, applications, and feedback.
- Websites: Build course hubs, event pages, and member spaces.
- Internal tools: Fit the way your team actually works.

Just describe it:

"A booking page for my cleaning business with reminders."
"A client portal for my agency with project updates."
"A CRM that finds leads who need a follow-up."

Taskade turns your idea into an app you can use and share.

2,400+ FREE APP KITS

Don't know where to start? Explore Taskade App Factory.

Choose a ready-made CRM, dashboard, client portal, or tracker. Clone an App Kit, add your data, and customize it with a prompt.

Clone. Customize. Publish. Make it yours.

PUT AI AGENTS TO WORK

Build AI agents for sales, support, research, scheduling, and operations.

- Give agents knowledge from PDFs, documents, links, and projects.
- Answer questions, analyze data, and draft replies.
- Help update records and move tasks forward.
- Bring multiple agents together on complex work.
- Choose an AI model, or let Auto pick for you.

Your agents work alongside your team, connected to your workspace.

AUTOMATE THE FOLLOW-UP

Your software can do more than store information.

- Trigger workflows from forms, schedules, emails, webhooks, and app events.
- Send reminders, follow-ups, summaries, and reports.
- Let AI categorize requests, prioritize tasks, and route work.
- Add conditions, decisions, and human approvals.
- Connect 100+ integrations, including Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Stripe, and GitHub.

Keep work moving from an incoming request to a completed task.

Set it up. Let it run.

YOUR APP. YOUR WORKSPACE.

Publish apps to the web and share with a link. Give clients their own sign-in. Connect a custom domain on eligible paid plans.

Customers can use your app on phone or desktop. Your team can work in the app or the Taskade workspace.

Projects, data, AI agents, and automations stay connected.

One app for your business. One workspace powering it.

YOUR TASKS. NOTES. PROJECTS.

Already use Taskade for to-do lists, notes, and planning? It's all still here. Keep your projects and use AI only when you want to.

Organize work with:

- List, Board, Table, and Calendar
- Mind Map and Docs
- Gantt Chart for timelines (paid)
- Actionsheet and Org Chart (paid)

Assign tasks, comment, chat, and collaborate in real time. Stay in sync across mobile, web, and desktop.

Built for business owners, agencies, freelancers, teams, and creators. Start with a to-do list. Build a business system when you need one.

POWERED BY WORKSPACE DNA

Projects remember.
Agents think.
Automations execute.

Taskade Genesis connects your work, knowledge, and workflows so your software can grow with your business.

ONE PROMPT. ONE APP. ONE LIVING WORKSPACE.

Imagine it. Run it live. Build without permission.

Some AI features, integrations, triggers, advanced views, and higher usage limits require a paid plan.
